title: WXML language server initialization options
description: The object passed as initialize.initializationOptions, including through a .zed settings configuration. By default, omitted, null, {} or {"apps": []} enables zero-config lazy discovery. Set apps only to pin explicit roots; explicit mode does not scan for app.json or search ancestor directories for tsconfig.json. The server also treats an omitted or null initializationOptions value as the default; this schema describes the object form. Restart the language server after changing these options.

apps.description: Optional explicit Mini Program roots. Omitted or [] enables zero-config lazy discovery: for each opened WXML, the nearest app.json and independently the nearest tsconfig.json are found by walking up to the workspace root, and workspace-package sources are discovered from the root package.json workspaces field or pnpm-workspace.yaml, but only packages named in the app package dependencies/devDependencies/peerDependencies are mounted. Explicit entries pin boundaries; canonical app roots must be unique, and distinct apps may share a projectRoot. Existence, canonical uniqueness, containment and symlink targets are checked by the server, not by JSON Schema.

root.description: Workspace-relative directory containing app.json. '.' or './' means the workspace root. Required for each explicit app; no directory or tsconfig inference occurs. After canonicalization it must be inside both the workspace and projectRoot. Different entries must not resolve to the same app directory.

projectRoot.description: TypeScript project directory, relative to the workspace (not to root). Omitted or null defaults to root. The server uses tsconfig.json directly in this directory if present; it does not search ancestors. This directory must contain root and remain within the workspace after canonicalization.

tsconfig.description: Optional workspace-relative tsconfig.json file. Omitted or null uses tsconfig.json directly in projectRoot without searching ancestors. An explicit file must exist and remain inside projectRoot after canonicalization.

dependencies.description: Workspace-relative package directories whose TypeScript/JavaScript sources join this app's type-backend snapshot. Omitted or [] keeps only the app's own source. Each directory must exist inside projectRoot and contain a valid package.json; its exports map becomes TypeScript paths aliases. List every workspace package the app imports. The server never scans node_modules or infers dependencies.

relativeDirectory.description: An existing workspace-relative directory, or '.' / './' for the workspace itself. Forward and backward slashes are normalized; leading ./ segments are allowed. Absolute, drive-letter and UNC paths, parent components, interior '.' components, empty components, trailing separators other than './', control characters and specified zero-width/bidirectional format characters are rejected. The server enforces at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes. JSON Schema maxLength counts Unicode code points, not bytes, so this 4096-character bound is necessary but not sufficient for non-ASCII paths. Canonical paths must remain inside the workspace; internal symlinks are allowed, escaping symlinks are rejected. Filesystem checks require the server and cannot be expressed by this schema.
